subject: Schedule: Redwood platform walkthrough — onboarding new gatekeepers
messages:
From: Jamie Lin <jamie.lin@acmecorp.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acmecorp.com
Date: 2027-11-21T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Redwood platform walkthrough — onboarding new gatekeepers

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the quick run of materials last week. We're excited to move forward — the leadership here asked us to bring a couple additional gatekeepers into the session so they can sign off: Nadia Park (Security), Danielle Shaw (Infrastructure) and our procurement lead (I'll add Liz on the next reply).

Current ask: Can we hold the demo the week of Nov 29? Right now Nov 30, 10:00 AM PT looks workable for product & PM, but the new folks asked to join and we may need to expand the slot or split the meeting so everyone gets the right level of detail. Also note Nadia is traveling Nov 29-Dec 2 (SFO->LON) and might not be available in that window.

High level: they want a technical architecture walk (security/internals), then a short procurement/pricing Q&A. Can Redwood do a two-part session or a single extended run-through?

Appreciate quick confirmation so I can lock internal calendars.

Thanks,
Jamie
Account Exec | Acme Corp
jamie.lin@acmecorp.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Lin <jamie.lin@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-21T10:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood platform walkthrough — onboarding new gatekeepers

Jamie — great, thanks for the heads up and the attendee names. We can absolutely accommodate the extra reviewers; given the mix (security + infra + procurement) I recommend splitting the meeting into two focused sessions: 1) Technical deep-dive for security & infra (60 min) and 2) Procurement/pricing + contract Q&A (30–45 min). Splitting keeps the detailed architecture discussion from getting lost in pricing questions and reduces risk of a forced follow-up.

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Option A: Dec 1, 11:00–12:00 (Technical) + Dec 2, 09:00–09:45 (Procurement)
- Option B: Dec 3, 09:30–10:30 (Technical) + Dec 3, 11:00–11:45 (Procurement) — two back-to-back blocks if that helps travel windows
- Option C: Single extended session Dec 4, 08:00–10:00 (we can do 90–120 min but that's heavy)

Attachments: I've attached a short technical outline and a pricing summary to help procurement prepare (redwood-technical-outline.pdf, procurement-pricing-summary.xlsx). We'll also prep a 15-slide deck tailored to Acme — I'll add the deck link in a follow-up.

A couple questions for planning:
- Does Nadia's travel rule out Dec 1 but allow Dec 3?
- Do you expect procurement to need legal on the call as well?
- Any specific security artifacts they'd like beforehand (SOC2, architecture diagram, data retention)? We can drop a one-pager in advance.

If you prefer, Marissa can own calendar updates and attendee orchestration — tagging her here. Vivek will lead the technical run and Karthik will be on the procurement pricing side.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
+1 (510) 555-0147
From: Jamie Lin <jamie.lin@acmecorp.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nadia Park <nadia.park@acmecorp.com>, Danielle Shaw <danielle.shaw@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2027-11-22T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood platform walkthrough — onboarding new gatekeepers

Irene — quick update. Procurement actually prefers a single consolidated slot so they can finalize internal approvals in one meeting. I've added Liz (liz.procure@acmecorp.com) to the thread.

Also, important travel note: Nadia (security) is on a redeye Nov 29 and won't be available until Dec 3 local. Danielle (infra) will be remote but flexible. So the team is leaning toward Dec 3 as the only time when everyone can attend. Would Redwood be able to do a two-part session on Dec 3 (back-to-back windows)?

If that doesn't work, procurement may ask for a written runbook + pricing sheet before they sign off, which would add another review cycle.

Jamie
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Lin <jamie.lin@acmecorp.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Nadia Park <nadia.park@acmecorp.com>, Danielle Shaw <danielle.shaw@acmecorp.com>, Liz Procure <liz.procure@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2027-11-22T13:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood platform walkthrough — onboarding new gatekeepers

Thanks Jamie — we can do Dec 3 and split it into two consecutive sessions so Nadia can catch the technical portion after travel and procurement can stay for the pricing segment. Proposed final plan (PT):
- Dec 3, 09:30–10:30 — Technical deep-dive (Vivek + Irene leading)
- Dec 3, 11:00–11:45 — Procurement + contract Q&A (Karthik + Marissa leading)

I'll create a single calendar series with two consecutive blocks and a single RSVP so it's clear for Acme. I'll also attach the demo deck (redwood-demo-deck.pptx) and a one-page security checklist to the invite notes.

Liz — can you confirm whether legal needs to be on the procurement block or if procurement can handle the initial pricing/concessions discussion and then loop legal only if needed?

Jamie — if those times look good I'll send the calendar invites and a prep packet (deck, architecture one-pager, and pricing summary). Also tagging Vivek who will cover the architecture and will bring a short diagram of our VPC/private deployment controls.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Liz Procure <liz.procure@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jamie Lin <jamie.lin@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Nadia Park <nadia.park@acmecorp.com>, Danielle Shaw <danielle.shaw@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2027-11-23T16:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood platform walkthrough — onboarding new gatekeepers

Marissa / team — Dec 3 works for procurement and legal will join the procurement block on standby (Liz Procure + two legal analysts). For the technical block, please include a short slide on network segmentation and key management (we need to validate HSM/KMS options).

Also: please attach the following before the session so we can expedite approval during the meeting:
- Network diagram (high level)
- SOC2 summary + location of the report or portal link
- Pricing summary (line items + any prospective discounts)

If you can add the network architecture slide to the deck and drop the SOC2 summary link in the Drive folder, we'll be ready to make a decision that day. Thanks for moving quickly on this.

—Liz
Liz Procure | Acme Corp Procurement
liz.procure@acmecorp.com
+1 (212) 555-0103
